assessments.rationale: Defer: new Q3 disclosure is a genuine evidence lead, but actual attachment unread, named owners and rights-adjustment chronology remain unresolved; current financials and an evidenced priced plan are missing.
assessments.fundamentals: [egm] The August 13 EGM states issued capital of EGP 2,390,296,339 and 23,902,963,390 issued/subscribed shares. Attendance of 51.72% does not identify a majority shareholder. [rights] The November 2025 proposal envisaged 10 billion new shares at EGP 0.10 plus 1% issue expenses. Later capital corroborates enlargement but not entitlement, subscription completion, ex-right, listing or effective dates. [egx][new-form] The new September 30 Article 30 wrapper proves submission; the actual ownership PDF remains unread. [ir][portal] Current group accounts, audit/review opinion, collections, delivery costs, related parties and financing remain unavailable. [old-earnings] The issuer reported 9M 2025 revenue of EGP 1.191 billion, gross profit of EGP 391 million, EBIT of EGP 59 million and net profit of EGP 159 million. Net profit above EBIT needs a finance/nonrecurring/tax bridge; this old promotional summary cannot establish current recurring profit or be annualized. Provider P/B 1.996 versus 22 same-industry peers with a median of 2.923 does not prove undervaluation; debt/equity 1.2049 versus 22 peers at 0.1361 and current ratio 1.2338 versus 22 peers at 1.4474 need dated statement reconciliation. Missing earnings fields are gaps, not losses. Property NAV/DCF is unavailable without dated project cash flows, current net debt, minority interests and reconciled shares.

assessments.risks: High qualitative evidence, action, project and financing risk. At EGP 0.250, one EGP 0.001 tick is 0.4%, materially affecting tight geometry. A close at the day low on 622.6 million shares weakens timing but proves neither distribution nor informed selling. The broad analytical regime is falling: 229 of 296 catalog stocks have fresh aligned EGP evidence; 17 are other-currency stocks. Only 6/74 Finance members are above SMA50; median 20-session return is -16.635%. This bucket mixes banks and property and is not a property index. No calibrated loss probability or matched benchmark alpha.
